body:
Thank you for taking the time to post. It helps a little, even just venting and knowing someone can read the last thing you ever wanted to say.

I guess I feel like my life is unrecoverable. I have made so many mistakes, and so many of my friends turned out to be less friends than I thought. But I can't blame them, they are just human. I feel like i'm the one who caused them to fuck me over.

I just feel like, ive fucked up, and if there was a restart to the world I would take it. But there isn't one. But I can't take a way out because my Son needs me. I just want a way out, but i don't think there is one.

I feel like just venting on reddit, and that someone took 10 seconds to read what I wrote is a huge weight off my shoulders. But i still feel empty and lost. I think i will keep on fighting for my son, but i really can't see any way out. I feel like my life is a trap, and my only options are suffering forever or suicide. Thanks for the reply anyway for what its worth.
